name: RPG World
author: ct
description: Top-down tile world in the spirit of RPG Maker on top of the novel engine: maps of square tiles in three layers (back, main, front) with a collision layer, walking on the grid with WASD or the arrows, events that talk, teleport or start battles with the action key E/F or on touch, random encounters. A map is a logical scene, so entry scenarios, ambience, saving and the dialog box work on maps unchanged; battles run on the turn-based platform with the game's battle core and return to the same cell. Scenario actions: rpg.battle, rpg.teleport.
